thesis: Gamma-pinned BTC proxy: dealers net long gamma every session for 30 days (ZGL $5.26, peak net_gex +$36.4M at $14.5) [STRUCT:gex], max-pain $14 for 6/26, and today's loud call premium was SOLD (net_flow -$1.61M; $14.5C 6/26 churned 63k contracts for only +514 OI [OI:biggest-increases]). Macro caps it (BTC below 50d/200d MAs into a hawkish 6/17 FOMC; regime prescribes 'iron condors in range' [MACRO:MarketRegime]) and all four desk agents returned RANGE. Sell the $14.5-$15 upside defined-risk around a $14 pin, small, because it is a busy name's normal day and a 26.5% short float makes the up-break violent.

primary.trigger: sell the upside on a tag/rejection of the $14.5 gamma + call wall

aggressive.trigger: fade into the $14.85-14.93 dark-pool supply band (richer call premium to sell)

fade.trigger: if BTC reclaims $65.2k and MARA closes > $15, abandon the short-call / flip to a small squeeze-chase long above the $15.5 long leg

invalidation.price: two daily closes above $15.00 (dominant call/GEX wall) — range cap broken; downside void below $13.83
invalidation.signal: GEX/DEX flips to short-gamma above $15, OR institutional-accumulation flips to distribution, OR cumulative premium flow net-bullish 3 sessions (real standing call-OI build, not churn) [INSIGHT:institutional-accumulation]
invalidation.macro: BTC reclaims its $65.2k 50d MA / breaks $66k resistance (squeeze trigger), or breaks below $60k (beta-5.35 down-cascade) [MACRO:BTC]

structures.note: mirrors the smart-money trade; long $15.5 leg caps the squeeze tail (phase-8b); profits if MARA <= 14.5 at 6/26
regime-prescribed range trade; short strikes outside the +/-4.1% 8-day expected move, bracketing the $14 pin; this is the 1.5%-of-book sizing anchor

tailwinds: [MACRO:VIX] VIX 16.4 falling — calm vol supports the pin
[MACRO:MarketRegime] UW regime guidance: 'half size, defined-risk, iron condors in range'

catalysts.event: ongoing BTC test of $65.2k 50d MA / $66k resistance (real trigger)

key_risks: 26.5% short float (~98.6M sh) is squeeze fuel — a BTC reclaim of $65.2k rips MARA through the $14.5/$15 walls and inverts the long-gamma pin into a dealer chase (phase-8b strongest bear point); short legs MUST stay defined-risk
beta 5.35 to a sub-MA BTC — a clean BTC break either way overwhelms the local gamma pin
IV at the 4.17th percentile — selling premium near 1y lows has a thin cushion if vol re-expands on a BTC move
